_docs: Heartbeat and quiet-hours config. Three readers, each spreading this file over its own defaults so a missing key falls back silently: LIFEOS/TOOLS/AgentJob.ts (quietHours: agent-job deliveries inside the window go to the heartbeat ledger instead of your phone), LIFEOS/HERMES/Heartbeat/Tick.ts (calendar, mail, location, quietHours), LIFEOS/HERMES/Heartbeat/ArtistScan.ts (artistScan). Times are 24h local `HH:MM`; a window that crosses midnight (start > end) is handled. mail.vipSenders are substrings matched against the From header, lowercase; mail.importantPatterns are case-insensitive regexes against the subject. artistScan reads starred rows from MUSIC/MusicReference.md plus extraArtists, minus skipArtists; homeRegionPatterns are regexes matched against event venue/region strings; discoveryWeekday like "Mon" enables the weekly worldwide sweep, "" disables it.
